name: Super: a jump in a ground dash
techNote: A floor ending at x 50, a spiked pit (x 50-900) and a far floor with the finish box (x 950-1350). From standing, dash right with the jump on dash frame 1: the dash is still on the ground, so the jump is the super (Movement.CheckForSuperJump: 805 up and 876 momentum right on tick 1). It peaks at y 288.8 and lands on the far floor at x 1099 (finish on tick 57). A running jump with no dash (`no-dash`) lands in the pit at x 554 and dies; the same jump with an air dash 5 ticks later (`air-dash`: the dash's distance without the super) gets to x 680 and dies.

ghosts.label: Super: dash, jump on its first frame
Running jump, no dash: into the pit
Jump, then air dash: into the pit
